items.q: Concerning my only concert in the country, if could have made a good Mack Senett comedy film.

ctx.x: The 29th we went to the U.S. Cultural Center to say 'goodbye' to the staff, Mr. Pango and the members of the band. We received numerous gifts and we were feeling sad. We were going to Dakar, Senegal and parting from the Ivory Coast gave Lily and I the feeling that we were losing a very dear friend.

We stayed in Dakar only three days. Concerning my only concert in the country, if could have made a good Mack Senett comedy film. A group of musicians of lead and bass guitars, a tenor sax man, drums and piano player were to accompany me. A rehearsal was called for late in the afternoon of my first day in Dakar at the club where this group worked. I asked the fellows if they knew certain compositions which were jazz classic, such as 'Peridido', 'Tea for Two', 'St.Louis Blues', etc.......They didn't. I asked them…
